phrases.text_l1: Writer of my symphony, play with me
Look into my eyes and see
People walk away but never say goodbye
Someone stole the moon tonight
Took my light, everything is black and white
Who's the fool who told you boys don't cry?
Hours and hours and powers
Life is no game, but it's ours, wild
The time goes wild
Every day I'm losing my mind
Holding on in this mysterious ride
Dancing in the storm, I got nothing to hide
Take it all and leave the world behind
Baby, promise me you'll hold me again
I'm still broken from this hurricane
This hurricane
Living in a fantasy, ecstasy
Everything is meant to be
We shall pass but love will never die

Life is no game, but it's ours, wild
The time goes wild

Holding on in this mysterious ride

This hurricane
It's hurricane

lesson_ratings.title: The Stolen Moon
lesson_ratings.reason: Rich vocabulary and metaphors, including 'symphony', 'stole the moon', and 'black and white'.

lesson_ratings.title: The Wild Ride
lesson_ratings.reason: Teaches useful expressions like 'losing my mind', 'mysterious ride', and 'dancing in the storm'.

lesson_ratings.title: Love Will Never Die
lesson_ratings.reason: Contains meaningful phrases such as 'broken from this hurricane', 'fantasy, ecstasy', and 'love will never die'.

lesson_ratings.title: The Wild Ride (Reprise)
lesson_ratings.reason: Exact repetition of lesson 2; no new vocabulary or structures to learn.

lesson_ratings.title: This Hurricane
lesson_ratings.reason: Reprise of the hurricane lines from lesson 3; adds no new teaching value.
